source_rules.bands: 20-observation simple mean plus/minus two sample standard deviations
source_rules.entry: five-node bottom-W arithmetic search, confirmed by current price above the current upper band
source_rules.exit: clear the long when 20-observation price standard deviation is below 0.0001
source_rules.tolerances: alpha and beta both fixed to 0.0001 absolute GBP/USD price units

lookahead_review: All node searches run backward from the current completed observation. No future index is read, but the source does not delay the resulting order to a separately auditable next period.
defects_and_ambiguities: Absolute 0.0001 thresholds are instrument-scale-specific and not portable from GBP/USD to ETFs.
The second condition compares a historical middle band with the current upper band, an unusual cross-time equality that may be intentional but is undocumented.
The contraction exit can be effectively unreachable on instruments whose nominal price or volatility scale differs from GBP/USD.
The hard-coded local drive, external CSV schema, and plotting-only workflow are not reproducible.
There is no performance accounting, transaction cost, uncertainty analysis, negative control, or portfolio test.
Repeated cumulative-sum mutation and label-style integer indexing are fragile across pandas versions.
independent_treatment: Test the literal absolute-unit rule and one predeclared dimensionless interpretation without tuning. Preserve the exact backward node ordering, require next-close realization, and add coverage, cost, control, and portfolio gates.
